svg.title: How signals trims the graph
svg.desc: All 630 functions in Codebase Memory as bars sized by cognitive complexity, 30 of them tests. signals drops the tests, ranks the rest by cognitive complexity, then cyclomatic, then length, and keeps the first 100, which the agent reads under a heading that names that order, starting with scanTypescriptWithAstGrep. A key explains cognitive, cyclomatic, and hidden_quadratic.
svg.text: how hard it is to follow; every level of nesting adds more
how many independent paths run through it
a linear search inside a loop
the first 100, its order named in the heading
